info.name: Moodle Talk Bridge
info.summary: Create and sync Nextcloud Talk rooms from Moodle course activities
info.description:
Connect your Moodle courses to Nextcloud Talk. A teacher adds a **Nextcloud Talk Session** to a course, and everything else happens on its own: the conversation is created, the class is added to it, and everyone joins with a single click. No extra logins, no manual room admin.
**What your users get**
- **One click into the meeting.** Teachers and students open the activity in Moodle and land in the Talk conversation already signed in. There is no second password to remember. - **Accounts created for them.** Course participants who do not yet have a Nextcloud account get one automatically the first time they join. - **The right people, with the right rights.** Teachers become moderators, students join as participants, and membership follows course enrolment — so the room stays correct as the class changes. - **Rooms that follow the course.** A conversation is created when the activity is added, renamed when the activity is renamed, and archived when it is removed. - **Private by design.** Every exchange between Moodle and Nextcloud is signed and verified, and only the Moodle sites you approve are accepted.
**Setting it up**
Everything is configured in your browser. No command line and no server access are required.
1. Make sure **Nextcloud Talk** is installed and enabled. 2. Install this app from **Apps → Integration**. 3. Open **Administration settings → Moodle Talk Bridge** and complete the six fields: your Nextcloud address, a shared secret, the account this app uses and its app password, your Moodle address, and the Moodle sites allowed to connect. 4. Enter the same shared secret in the Moodle plugin, then use **Test connection** there to confirm both halves are talking to each other.
Secrets are write-only. Once saved they are never displayed again, and leaving a secret field blank keeps the value already stored.
**Requirements**
- **Nextcloud Talk (spreed)** installed and enabled. This app drives Talk and does nothing on its own. - A Nextcloud account dedicated to this app, with an app password. - The companion Moodle plugin, [Nextcloud Talk for Moodle](https://elearning23.com/nextcloud-talk-for-moodle/), installed on your Moodle site.
**You also need the Moodle plugin**
This app is the Nextcloud half of the integration. The matching Moodle activity plugin, **Nextcloud Talk for Moodle**, is published by Brain Station 23. Download it, and read its installation guide, here:
**[https://elearning23.com/nextcloud-talk-for-moodle/](https://elearning23.com/nextcloud-talk-for-moodle/)**
Both halves are required — neither works on its own.
**Support**
For installation help, a demo or any question, contact [elearning@brainstation-23.com](mailto:elearning@brainstation-23.com).
